# Lorenzo Marchisio

> Personal site of Lorenzo Marchisio: engineer, founder and photographer, studying at Politecnico di Torino and moving from Cuneo, Italy, to Leuven, Belgium. It also presents his studio that builds websites for small businesses.

Every page is in English under /en/, Italian under /it/ and French under /fr/, with the same path after the language. The links below are the English ones.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lorenzomarchisio.me/en/): who Lorenzo is, as an engineer, a founder and a photographer, plus his journey from Cuneo to Leuven
- [Websites](https://lorenzomarchisio.me/en/websites/): fast, multilingual websites for small businesses anywhere in the world, at fixed prices
- [Website projects](https://lorenzomarchisio.me/en/websites/gallery/): websites built for small businesses
- [Photo gallery](https://lorenzomarchisio.me/en/gallery/): motorcycle, football and travel photographs from Slovenia and Croatia
- [CV](https://lorenzomarchisio.me/cv.pdf): curriculum vitae, PDF
